svg.desc: Median whole-process peak resident memory for the same 64 MiB HTTP/1 body: download to file 4.2 MiB; buffered 68.0 MiB. Three shuffled runs in Bend on Linux/WSL2. Total process RSS, not incremental memory or a process memory cap. File output and buffering differ in semantics; this is not a throughput comparison. Source: benchmarks/results/resources.json.
